identificationModule.briefTitle: Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of HSK39004 Inhalation Suspension in COPD
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Single-Arm, Open-Label Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of HSK39004 Inhalation Suspension in Patients With Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This clinical trial evaluates the long-term safety and efficacy of 3 mg HSK39004 Inhalation Suspension administered twice daily for 52 weeks in subjects aged 40 to 80 years with moderate-to-severe stable chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

interventions.name: HSK39004 Inhalation Suspension
interventions.description: Dosage Formulation: HSK39004 Inhalation suspension Dosage 3mg; Twice Daily for 52 weeks

primaryOutcomes.description: The incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs), assessed through vital signs, physical examinations, laboratory tests, 12-lead ECG parameters, and detailed adverse event monitoring.
